title: RightDerivedBaseChangeSingleUnit
statement: Let B, B′, C, C′ be abelian categories with derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and enough injectives in B and B′. Let G : B → C and G′ : B′ → C′ be additive, and beta : B → B′ and gamma : C → C′ additive exact functors [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology]. For e : G ⋙ gamma → beta ⋙ G′ and Y in B, let u_G(Y) be rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit from [lem-sbc-right-derived-single-unit-homology-comparison]. Then gamma⁺(u_G(Y)) followed by derived base change on Y[0] and R⁺G′ of the beta single-complex comparison equals the gamma single-complex comparison followed by the single complex of e(Y) and u_G′(beta(Y)). No left exactness of G or G′ is assumed.

proof.text: Put K = Y[0] in the homotopy category. Evaluate rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_fac at K, and expand rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChangeAux. The composition-comparison isomorphisms for identity transformations and the associators disappear. The equation now reads gamma⁺(unit_G(K)) followed by base change at Qh(K) equals the gamma localization comparison, Qh of the levelwise map e, unit_G′ at beta(K), and R⁺G′ of the inverse beta localization comparison.

Expand u_G(Y). Naturality of derived base change along the canonical isomorphism Qh(K) → Y[0] transports the preceding equation to Y[0]. The beta localization comparison, that canonical transport, and the beta single-complex comparison compose to Qh of the isomorphism beta(K) → (beta(Y))[0], followed by the canonical transport for beta(Y). This coherence is checked under the faithful inclusion D⁺ → D using the definitions of the single-complex and localization comparisons.

Use naturality of unit_G′ along beta(K) → (beta(Y))[0] to move this isomorphism before the unit. The remaining prefix equals the gamma single-complex comparison followed by the single-complex map of e(Y) and the inverse G′ single-complex comparison. Check this under the faithful inclusion D⁺ → D: expand the comparison maps, apply naturality of the localization comparison for gamma, and apply naturality of e to the cochain single-complex comparison. The suffix is precisely u_G′(beta(Y)).

theorem rightDerivedBaseChange_single_unit (e : G ⋙ γ ⟶ β ⋙ G') (Y : B) :
    γ.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map (G.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit Y) ≫
      (rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange e).app
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B 0).obj Y) ≫
      G'.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
        ((β.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app Y) =
    (γ.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app (G.obj Y) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C' 0).map (e.app Y) ≫
      G'.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit (β.obj Y)
